title: Build molecular structures
action: Build the isotactic cis-1,4-poly(1,3-pentadiene) polymer chain with two-fold helical symmetry (s(2/1) line repetition group) and construct the initial crystal packing models for the experimental structure and model B using the fractional coordinates and unit cell parameters provided in the instruction; model A will be obtained from the packing energy scan in Step 2.
description: Prepare input coordinate files for the molecular mechanics engine using the explicit data supplied in the instruction.

title: Packing energy minimization to determine predicted structure
action: Using the MM2_85 force field and periodic boundary conditions in the P2(1)2(1)2(1) space group, perform packing energy minimization to scan the a and b unit cell axes and the chain translation z and rotation ω. Identify the two local minima corresponding to model A and model B. For the global minimum, extract the optimal unit cell parameters a, b, c (c held near 8.15 Å) and the full set of backbone bond angles and dihedral angles.
description: Core calculation that reproduces the 1990 prediction. The evidence file may record the coordinates and energies of the found minima.

title: Compute lattice energies for fixed packing models
action: For each of the three packing models, compute the initial lattice energy (E_in) and the optimized energy (E_opt) after relaxation of atomic coordinates under fixed unit cell axes, all in kJ per mol of monomeric unit. Use the fractional coordinates and cell axes as specified in the instruction (experimental and model B given directly; model A from Step 2).
description: Reproduces the energy values of Table 3 using the specified coordinates and fixed cell axes.

title: Extract predicted structural parameters
action: From the global minimum structure (lowest energy) obtained in Step 2, extract the unit cell parameters a, b, c (in Å) and the backbone bond angles and dihedral angles as enumerated in the instruction. Write these to /app/outputs/calculated_structure_properties.csv.
description: Contains the calculated unit cell parameters and chain conformational parameters for the predicted crystal structure. The required parameters are: a, b, c (Å); bond angles C(1)-C(2)-C(3), C(2)-C(3)-C(4), C(3)-C(4)-C(1'), C(4)-C(1')-C(2'), C(3)-C(4)-C(5) (degrees); dihedral angles C(1)-C(2)-C(3)-C(4), C(2)-C(3)-C(4)-C(1'), C(3)-C(4)-C(1')-C(2'), C(4)-C(1')-C(2')-C(3'), C(2)-C(3)-C(4)-C(5) (degrees).
output_schema: CSV with three columns: parameter (string), value (number), unit (string, e.g. 'Å' or 'degrees'). Required rows as listed in the description.

title: Collect lattice energies
action: Extract the initial and optimized lattice energies per monomeric unit (in kJ/mol) for the experimental crystal structure, model A, and model B from the energy calculations performed in Step 3. Write these to /app/outputs/lattice_energies.json.
description: JSON file containing the lattice energies before and after coordinate relaxation for the three packing models.
output_schema: JSON object with six numeric keys: experimental_Ein, experimental_Eopt, model_A_Ein, model_A_Eopt, model_B_Ein, model_B_Eopt. All values in kJ per mole of monomeric unit.
